body: Session start 2026-09-29. The owner invoked interphase:prototype asking for a new logbook session to build the updated Meadow (the Garden page renamed) from the new prototype export in docs/prototype (Meadow.dc.html is the primary per its README; Meadow v2, Meadow Scene, Onboarding are new; Field Notes.dc.html and md-scrapbook.js modified, all uncommitted in the working tree). Scope named by the owner: per-user per-year randomized meadow; year, day-by-day and year-so-far UI; viewing past years; hover or select a flower to see its planted date; performance to 366 flowers on macOS and Android (the current meadow is laggy and unusable on Android as flowers grow) without changing the look or feel. Flow: spec with interphase, owner approval, then mitosis dispatch. Before the thread existed: read the interphase phases, prototype playbook, template, practices, questioning and items guides; listed docs/specs (prior related specs: dark-mode-garden-skybox, live-run-defects-and-garden-speed).
